identity.name: Aquatimer Automatic 2000

case.bezel: unidirectional rotating dive bezel with SafeDive spring-loaded locking system

identity.one_liner: A 2,000-meter dive watch built around IWC's SafeDive bezel-lock mechanism, from a collection IWC has scaled back sharply in recent years.

narrative.story: The Aquatimer line carried IWC's dive-watch identity, distinguished by the SafeDive system — a spring-loaded inner ring that locks the external rotating bezel in place and only lets it turn in the safe direction, adding a mechanical safeguard against accidental bezel movement underwater. IWC reduced the Aquatimer collection significantly in the early 2020s, cutting it from a multi-model dive-watch range down to a much smaller presence in the current catalog.
narrative.collector_notes: Because IWC has reduced Aquatimer's catalog footprint, confirm current availability and the exact reference directly with an authorized dealer rather than assuming any specific Aquatimer reference is still orderable — this is a line in genuine flux, not a stable long-running reference.
